pull.title: KAFKA-21252: Use partition 0's replication factor when adding partitions
pull.body:
When adding partitions, the KRaft controller takes the replication
factor from the first partition returned by iterating the topic's
partitions. This order depends on the hash layout, so it is not always
partition 0. This patch uses partition 0, like the ZooKeeper-based
broker did.

This also applies to manual assignments: their replica count is now
checked against partition 0's replication factor.

The Javadoc of NewPartitions#increaseTo now says that new partitions
follow partition 0's replication factor. This matches the old ZooKeeper
behavior; there is no API change.
